text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of the Takarazuka Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Yo. Finally, huh...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I saw it, "The 1st." Number one again? 
You're an idol as always.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
On the other hand, my name sits at eighth. 
Given my record so far, it's a fair 
evaluation, but... man, it really stings.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...No. That's not really it, is it?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You're super excited, aren't you? My heart 
is pounding fast too, after all.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh... No matter how innocent the little 
lady may be, I can't fool her, can I?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: "Buena. I'm really grateful to you."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Buena! Buena! Buena! Buena! Buena! Buena! 
BUE-NA-VIS-TAAAA!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa. ...Is that the Buena fan club? With 
the Spring Grand Prix coming up, looks 
like she's gained even more fans~.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
You act like an old fan, but aren't you 
new here too?! Come on, let's cheer just 
as loud as them! —Buena-chan, win again 
for us~!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to your popularity... the entire 
venue is swelling with massive 
anticipation.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
—That's why this'll be the ultimate upset. 
I'm really glad you're in my generation.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ... There won't be any upsets, you know?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Hooh?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Because I know very well just how hard 
you've been working, Nakayama-san."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
If Nakayama-san wins, it will be the 
result of her daily hard work... It won't 
be a fluke.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
…………Whoa, whoa. No matter how you look at 
it, you were totally supposed to fire back 
at me just now.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ? Umm...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"At any rate, I can vividly feel how 
motivated Nakayama-san is. But..."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I'm carrying the hopes of so many people 
too. There's no way I can lose!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...My selfishness versus your altruism. A 
battle to see which is stronger... I 
suppose.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I like it. Let's clash head-on, fair and 
square.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yes! Please take good care of me!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.
choice_data_list:
Nakayama had incredible fighting spirit, 
huh.

Nakayama had incredible fighting spirit, 
didn't she?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. She must've put in an incredible 
amount of preparation just for today."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I've got to flip the switch and get 
serious too!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista is very calm. However, she 
carries so many expectations again today 
that there's no telling how she feels deep 
down...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Fufu. ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine now. I don't really get nervous 
at all these days.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, everyone's expectations make 
me happy. I just keep thinking about 
living up to them, over and over... and 
reaching that spectacular view!"
choice_data_list:
You're not too tense, are you? Are you 
really okay?

You're not too tense, are you? Are you 
really okay?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You're being an awful worrywart today, 
aren't you? What's the matter?
choice_data_list:
It's not like I can truly understand what 
you're feeling, so...

It's not like I can truly understand your 
senses, but...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
choice_data_list: I'd rather worry too much than not enough.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Because you're so dependable... 
I really am going to be just fine.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I will win. I'll win... and live 
up to everyone's expectations.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'll see the breathtaking view I 
wish to reach— and convey it all to you!
